partnership_angle: Referral/channel partner and sandbox tester - NOT an attestation feeder. ARORA is a readiness and internal-audit consultancy (ISO-centric, SOC 2 readiness only), so they cannot sign SOC 2 reports; they hand clients off to certification/audit partners like Prescient Security and Barr Advisory. That makes them a two-way channel: (1) they can embed or white-label the LoxeAI scan inside their readiness and fractional-vCISO engagements to speed up flat-fee delivery, and (2) their partner network gives LoxeAI a bridge into actual attest firms. They are demonstrably automation-friendly (Drata, Vanta, ISMS.online partners; market themselves on AI-assisted audits), so a sandbox validation ask fits their brand. Caveats keeping the score moderate: no AWS/cloud specialization signals, founded 2016 (just outside the 8-year window), and startups are one of several client segments (they also serve mid-market/enterprise).
pitch_note: Steve, you've built ARORA around virtual, AI-assisted readiness work on Drata and Vanta - LoxeAI is a natural extension of that stack for your AWS-native startup clients. It's an AWS-focused SOC 2 readiness scanner; I'd love 20 minutes to have you run it against a sandbox AWS account and tear the findings apart as an auditor. If it holds up, your pre-audit and vCISO clients could run the scan first and walk into readiness engagements ~80% of the way there - making your flat-fee model even more profitable per engagement.
